races.paceDynamic: With no confirmed front runner in this 9-horse field, expect a muddling early pace as horses like Man Of The Sea, The Craftymaster, and Mind Hunter all prefer to settle behind. This lack of natural pace-setters will likely see someone reluctantly take it up, but the tempo should be modest through the early stages. The combination of soft ground and 2m1f distance means stamina will be at a premium in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with proven stamina who can quicken late, as the slow early pace will set up a sprint finish where class and finishing kick become decisive.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Burn Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow with no horse willing to commit
scenarios.body: The lack of pace will compress the field turning for home, creating a cavalry charge finish where the classiest stayers with the best turn of foot prevail. Horses like Man Of The Sea and The Craftymaster, both proven at this trip with winning form, will be perfectly positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Modest Tempo Staying Test
scenarios.trigger: If one horse takes up the running at a steady tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The consistent pace will turn this into a proper stamina examination where proven stayers can grind out the finish. This suits horses with multiple runs over extended distances who can sustain their effort.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses get in each other's way with no clear pace scenario developing
scenarios.body: The messy tempo will create traffic problems and force jockeys into reactive riding, benefiting the most experienced campaigners who can navigate trouble. Veterans like Man Of The Sea and Mind Hunter thrive in scrappy contests.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Apprentice Inexperience Factor
scenarios.trigger: If the young jockeys misjudge the pace and go too fast early
scenarios.body: The stronger early pace will stretch the field and expose fitness doubts, particularly hurting horses returning from long breaks. Only the fittest stayers will last home.

races.paceDynamic: Son Of Astar will break prominently and likely lead with minimal pressure in the early stages, as 14 of the 15 runners are hold-up horses. Darkened Edge may track in second but lacks the natural early speed to challenge Son Of Astar's position. The gentle early fractions will create a sprint finish over the final 2f as the hold-up brigade comes home in a wall of horses. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can avoid traffic, as the large field of hold-up horses will create a bottleneck in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Son Of Astar Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Astar gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: He will dictate comfortable fractions and have enough left to resist the late charge, with Darkened Edge best placed to track and challenge. The early leaders avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the hold-up horses.

scenarios.body: The superior class of Harry Mole and Legendsoftheland will tell as they sweep past tired leaders. Their hold-up style becomes an advantage if the early pace is honest enough to set up their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Horses with racing room and momentum will benefit while others get stopped in their run. Those drawn well or ridden with more urgency early will have crucial positional advantages over those buried in traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise From Rear
scenarios.trigger: If a well-handicapped outsider finds a clear passage late
scenarios.body: The soft ground will help stamina-laden types who stay on strongly when others tire. Lower-rated horses with less weight will benefit if the pace collapses and class becomes less important.

races.paceDynamic: Secret Harvest will set the pace with Doodling likely to press her early, creating a sustainable tempo in the soft conditions. With only two confirmed pace angles in an 11-runner field, the early gallop should be comfortable rather than punishing. The lack of pace pressure means Secret Harvest can dictate terms through steady fractions, while the hold-up horses face the challenge of making up ground on testing ground that typically favours those closer to the pace. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed to sit handy, as the soft going will make late swoops much harder to execute effectively.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Horse Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Harvest gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows her to build an unassailable lead, while the testing ground blunts any late challenges from the hold-up brigade. Her prominent style and recent good form make her perfectly suited to exploit these conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely and becomes crawling slow
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine speed allows the back markers to stay within striking distance and unleash superior finishing kicks on ground that suddenly plays fair to closers. Class and raw ability trump tactical positioning in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Improver
scenarios.trigger: If one of the newcomers or lightly raced fillies shows significant improvement
scenarios.body: The restricted nature of this contest means any filly taking a step forward from limited experience could outclass these exposed rivals. Fresh legs and untapped potential prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both Secret Harvest and Doodling fail to go forward as expected
scenarios.body: With no genuine pace setters, the race becomes a messy scramble where any horse with tactical speed can steal a march. The winner comes from those able to adapt quickly to the changing dynamics.

races.paceDynamic: Ship To Shore will take up the early running with Basilette and Virtual Hug tracking close behind, setting a steady gallop that won't be overly testing early. The lack of natural speed horses means the pace will be manageable through the middle stages, allowing the field to stay compact turning for home. With 10 of the 13 runners employing hold-up tactics, this creates a bunched finish where horses with turn of foot will be crucial. This pace scenario heavily favours the hold-up horses who can quicken late, particularly those with proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.trigger: If Basilette or Virtual Hug can sustain their effort from the front group
scenarios.body: The prominent racers use their forward positions to steal a march on the hold-up brigade. Their early positioning proves decisive when the late charge comes too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Ship To Shore goes too slowly and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test over the final two furlongs. Horses with the best turn of foot regardless of early position will prevail in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Leader Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Ship To Shore gets uncontested fractions and maintains momentum
scenarios.body: The front-runner takes advantage of the modest pace to build an unassailable lead. The hold-up horses' kicks come too late to reel in the escaped leader.

This race shape clearly favors prominent racers and those that can track the pace rather than hold-up horses who need a strong gallop to close into.

scenarios.body: The single pace-setter controls the race without pressure, leaving insufficient pace collapse for the large contingent of hold-up horses. Prominent runners like Bosom Pals and Aneirin's Sword can track the tempo and have enough left to resist the late closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses sit closer than usual allowing a moderate early pace
scenarios.body: The race develops into a sprint finish with horses bunched up turning for home. This tactical scenario can suit the more versatile types who can adapt their running style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse

scenarios.body: An unusually slow pace throughout allows every horse to remain in contention deep into the race. The finish becomes a pure staying test favoring horses with the strongest final furlong kick.
